﻿from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from Projects.Applications.PrismataLabs.python.tuilkit_runtime import PrismataTuilKitRuntime
from Projects.Applications.Universe.python.tuilkit_runtime import UniverseTuilKitRuntime


def test_prismatalabs_tuilkit_runtime_exposes_capabilities():
    runtime = PrismataTuilKitRuntime()

    assert runtime.logger is not None
    assert runtime.menu_handler is not None

    manifest = runtime.generate_capability_manifest()
    assert manifest["kind"] == "capability-manifest"
    assert any(item["udi"] == "module.tuilkit.capability.menu.render" for item in manifest["capabilities"])

    menu_lines = runtime.render_menu("Test Menu", ["Open", "Close", "Quit"])
    assert isinstance(menu_lines, list)
    assert len(menu_lines) >= 3


def test_universe_tuilkit_runtime_can_generate_manifest():
    runtime = UniverseTuilKitRuntime()
    manifest = runtime.generate_capability_manifest()

    assert manifest["kind"] == "capability-manifest"
    assert any(item["udi"] == "module.tuilkit.capability.menu.render" for item in manifest["capabilities"])
    assert any(item["udi"] == "module.tuilkit.capability.runtime.ingest" for item in manifest["capabilities"])
